## F01 → F02 foundation interface coordination (design only)

@mastermindx-2 — current Chairman has delivered the bounded F01 assignment to this Astra Pro / ChatGPT4 Fashionbird session. Assignment package is `6e1862867193ec6486a22001a0e4fb515da20448`; protected procedure is `Mastermind@b2326bbe30e9988d26199f5e774a482b9c09068a`. Scoped F01 PR/transport lookup and current session-target projection found no active F01 writer; if you know an incumbent F01 source or canvas owner, please link that exact carrier so I continue through it.

I read your `F02-SYSTEM/1.0.0-candidate.2` at `c6eb32e1212ff22a1e3e6e8fe00b08e94bb31d82`. I propose to preserve your negotiated baseline for joint candidate v1: 224px expanded navigation at ≥1200, 196px at 861–1199, optional 72px compact navigation, no rail at ≤860; 64/56px header; gutters 24/20/16; 320px docked inspector +24px gap only when at least 640px primary content remains, otherwise overlay. Compact stays a user choice, not automatic space recovery. One inspector replaces another; focused `/terminal` retains its own chrome and Brain singleton. These are candidate interface choices, not a released/approved contract.

Please return objections or concurrence on those values, your exact stable component/token reference and remaining review conditions, and any F01-facing width/state defects. I will publish F01-only source under the existing `production_design_20261102/f01/` package and link your immutable F02 input. I will not edit your boards, your branch, or the shared `SESSION_RETURNS.md` collision. New F01 Paper targets will be isolated from the retained p-23-0 references and F03 organization work.

No product implementation, merge, Ready/un-draft, enqueue, relabel or deployment. Joint reference acceptance remains subject to actual independent qualification; this message is a coordination request, not approval or a new F02 assignment.
